The two textbook problems rebuilt in ANSYS Workbench — predict, run, compare, explain: the heat plate and the cantilever, the mesh study, what a stress plot averages, four wrong models and their signatures, the first verified run of your project model, and how verification differs from validation in the hybrid project.Dua masalah buku teks dibina semula dalam ANSYS Workbench — ramal, run, banding, terangkan: plat haba dan cantilever, kajian mesh, apa yang dipuratakan oleh plot stress, empat model yang salah dan tanda-tandanya, run pertama yang disahkan bagi model projek anda, dan beza verification dengan validation dalam projek hibrid.

    What this part coversApa yang bahagian ini liputi

    Five sessions of hand calculation end here, at the computer. Every object in ANSYS Workbench has a name from those sessions — element order is the choice of shape functions, a Fixed Support is an essential condition, a Force on an edge becomes the consistent loads you integrated by hand — so every number on the screen can be predicted before Solve is pressed. The habit this part builds is the one the project is marked on: reaction first, then a hand estimate, then refinement, and two independent tools that must agree.Lima sesi pengiraan tangan berakhir di sini, di hadapan komputer. Setiap objek dalam ANSYS Workbench mempunyai nama daripada sesi-sesi itu — element order ialah pilihan shape function, Fixed Support ialah essential condition, Force pada tepi menjadi consistent load yang anda integrate dengan tangan — jadi setiap nombor pada skrin boleh diramal sebelum butang Solve ditekan. Tabiat yang dibina di sini ialah tabiat yang dinilai dalam projek: reaction dahulu, kemudian anggaran tangan, kemudian refine, dan dua alat bebas yang mesti sepakat.

Build a 2D steady-state thermal model and a 2D plane-stress model in ANSYS Workbench, with units, material, thickness, mesh, supports and loads entered correctly.Membina model 2D steady-state thermal dan model 2D plane stress dalam ANSYS Workbench, dengan unit, bahan, ketebalan, mesh, support dan load dimasukkan dengan betul.
    2. Map every ANSYS object to the hand calculation: element order, consistent loads, essential and natural conditions, averaged and element stresses, reactions.Memadankan setiap objek ANSYS dengan pengiraan tangan: element order, consistent load, essential dan natural condition, stress averaged dan element, reaction.
    3. Predict a result before running it, run a mesh study, and check the model against one independent calculation before reading any contour plot.Meramal keputusan sebelum run, menjalankan kajian mesh, dan menyemak model dengan satu pengiraan bebas sebelum membaca sebarang contour plot.
    4.     1. From the textbook to WorkbenchDari buku teks ke Workbench

    ≈ 9 min

    Nothing in ANSYS Workbench is new mathematics. Its six cells are the six steps you have done with pen and paper: Engineering Data is [E] or k, Geometry is the domain, Mesh chooses the shape functions, Setup holds the loads and the essential conditions, Solution solves [K]{U} = {R}, and Results is [E][B]{û}. What is new is speed, and with speed the temptation to believe the first colour plot.Tiada matematik baharu dalam ANSYS Workbench. Enam sel-nya ialah enam langkah yang sudah anda buat dengan pen dan kertas: Engineering Data ialah [E] atau k, Geometry ialah domain, Mesh memilih shape function, Setup memegang load dan essential condition, Solution menyelesaikan [K]{U} = {R}, dan Results ialah [E][B]{û}. Yang baharu ialah kelajuan, dan bersama kelajuan datang godaan untuk mempercayai contour plot pertama.

    Worked conversion · the cantilever’s load and mesh (Activity 1)Penukaran bekerja · load dan mesh cantilever (Aktiviti 1)

    The text gives qy = −5 kN m−1 on the 2 m right edge of a 0.01 m plate: force per unit length of edge, thickness already included. The dialog wants either a total Force or a Pressure:Teks memberi qy = −5 kN m−1 pada tepi kanan 2 m bagi plat 0.01 m: daya per unit panjang tepi, ketebalan sudah termasuk. Kotak dialog mahukan sama ada jumlah Force atau Pressure:

    The hand mesh has rectangular 2 m × 1 m elements, so it is set by divisions per edge, not by one element size (an Element Size of 1 m would give 4 × 2). The plate’s 16 × 16 mesh is a single size:Mesh tangan mempunyai element segi empat tepat 2 m × 1 m, jadi ia ditetapkan dengan bilangan bahagian setiap tepi, bukan dengan satu saiz element (Element Size 1 m akan memberi 4 × 2). Mesh 16 × 16 plat ialah satu saiz:

    Element Order: Linear for the hand element. Mechanical never asks for nodal loads: it integrates the Force or Pressure into the consistent loads of Plane Stress Parts 2–3 itself.Element Order: Linear untuk element tangan. Mechanical tidak pernah meminta nodal load: ia sendiri meng-integrate Force atau Pressure menjadi consistent load seperti dalam Plane Stress Part 2–3.

    The most common failure in student projectsKegagalan paling biasa dalam projek pelajarA wrong unit system: geometry drawn in mm with loads in N and E in Pa is a model of a different structure, and nothing in the solver objects. A wrong unit shows up as a factor of 10³ or 10⁶ somewhere — which is why every result is predicted first.Unit system yang salah: geometri dilukis dalam mm dengan load dalam N dan E dalam Pa ialah model struktur yang lain, dan solver tidak membantah langsung. Unit yang salah muncul sebagai faktor 10³ atau 10⁶ di suatu tempat — sebab itulah setiap keputusan diramal dahulu.
    Key pointsPerkara utama
    • Six Workbench cells = six hand steps; the software integrates and assembles, you decide the idealisation.Enam sel Workbench = enam langkah tangan; perisian meng-integrate dan assemble, anda menentukan idealisation.
    • qy = −5 kN m−1 on a 2 m edge, t = 0.01 m: Force −10 000 N or Pressure −500 kPa; Pressure × edge area gives the Force back.qy = −5 kN m−1 pada tepi 2 m, t = 0.01 m: Force −10 000 N atau Pressure −500 kPa; Pressure × luas tepi memberi semula Force.
    • Hand mesh: Edge Sizing 2 and 2, Linear. Plate 16 × 16: Element Size 0.0625 m.Mesh tangan: Edge Sizing 2 dan 2, Linear. Plat 16 × 16: Element Size 0.0625 m.

    A load of 3 kN m−1 acts on a 1.5 m edge of a plate 0.02 m thick. The Pressure to enter isLoad 3 kN m−1 bertindak pada tepi 1.5 m bagi plat setebal 0.02 m. Pressure yang perlu dimasukkan ialah

    p = q/t = 3/0.02 = 150 kN m−2 = 150 kPa. Check: 150 × (1.5 × 0.02) = 4.5 kN = q × 1.5, the total Force. 4.5 is that Force in kN, not a pressure; 0.06 is q × t.p = q/t = 3/0.02 = 150 kN m−2 = 150 kPa. Semak: 150 × (1.5 × 0.02) = 4.5 kN = q × 1.5, iaitu jumlah Force. 4.5 ialah Force itu dalam kN, bukan pressure; 0.06 ialah q × t.

    2. Demo 1 · the heat plateDemo 1 · plat haba

    ≈ 7 min

    The first demonstration is the plate of Heat Transfer Part 2: 1 m square, k = 300 W m−1 K−1, 600 W m−3 generated inside, 0 °C on the top and left edges, nothing on the other two. Its answers are already known, so the run is a test of the model, not a source of new numbers.Demonstrasi pertama ialah plat Heat Transfer Part 2: segi empat sama 1 m, k = 300 W m−1 K−1, 600 W m−3 dijana di dalam, 0 °C pada tepi atas dan kiri, tiada apa pada dua tepi lagi. Jawapannya sudah diketahui, jadi run ini menguji model, bukan sumber nombor baharu.

    The linear 2 × 2 run uses the same element and the same consistent {q} as the hand calculation, so it must agree to three or four decimals. The refined runs measure how far the hand mesh was from the answer:Run linear 2 × 2 menggunakan element dan {q} consistent yang sama seperti pengiraan tangan, jadi ia mesti sepakat hingga tiga atau empat tempat perpuluhan. Run yang di-refine mengukur sejauh mana mesh tangan daripada jawapan:

    The independent check: heat in = heat outSemakan bebas: haba masuk = haba keluar

    The reaction at a node with a prescribed temperature is the heat that must be removed there to hold it at 0 °C: the struck rows of [K]{T} − {R}, exactly as for the forces at a support. Their sum over both cold edges must equal what the body generates, on any mesh. Thickness does not change the temperatures; it scales every heat flow, so read the reaction with the model’s thickness in mind.Reaction pada node dengan suhu yang ditetapkan ialah haba yang mesti dikeluarkan di situ untuk mengekalkannya pada 0 °C: baris yang dibuang [K]{T} − {R}, sama seperti daya pada support. Jumlahnya pada kedua-dua tepi sejuk mesti sama dengan haba yang dijana oleh jasad, pada sebarang mesh. Ketebalan tidak mengubah suhu; ia menskala setiap aliran haba, jadi baca reaction dengan mengambil kira ketebalan model.

    If the 2 × 2 run does not give 0.6214Jika run 2 × 2 tidak memberi 0.6214Check the node count first: 9 nodes means the hand mesh, 25 means a 4 × 4 mesh (corner 0.5968). Then the element order: Program Controlled gives quadratic elements. Both are common, and both are found in a minute because the answer was predicted.Semak bilangan node dahulu: 9 node bermaksud mesh tangan, 25 bermaksud mesh 4 × 4 (bucu 0.5968). Kemudian element order: Program Controlled memberi quadratic element. Kedua-duanya biasa, dan kedua-duanya ditemui dalam seminit kerana jawapannya sudah diramal.
    Key pointsPerkara utama
    • Linear 2 × 2: 0.6214 at the corner, 0.4821 at the mid-edges — the hand calculation, to four decimals.Linear 2 × 2: 0.6214 di bucu, 0.4821 di tengah tepi — pengiraan tangan, hingga empat tempat perpuluhan.
    • 16 × 16: 0.5898, +0.02% from the converged 0.5897; the hand mesh is +5.4%.16 × 16: 0.5898, +0.02% daripada 0.5897 yang converge; mesh tangan +5.4%.
    • Reaction on the cold edges = −Q A t: heat out equals heat generated on every mesh.Reaction pada tepi sejuk = −Q A t: haba keluar sama dengan haba dijana pada setiap mesh.
    Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

    Your “linear 2 × 2” plate run shows 0.5968 °C at the corner instead of 0.6214. The most likely cause isRun plat “linear 2 × 2” anda menunjukkan 0.5968 °C di bucu dan bukannya 0.6214. Punca yang paling mungkin ialah

    0.5968 is exactly the 4 × 4 linear value: an Element Size of 0.25 m instead of 0.5 m. Thickness cannot change a temperature in this problem; a source in the wrong unit would change it by a large factor, not by 4%. Check Mesh → Statistics: 25 nodes.0.5968 ialah tepat nilai linear 4 × 4: Element Size 0.25 m dan bukannya 0.5 m. Ketebalan tidak boleh mengubah suhu dalam masalah ini; sumber dalam unit yang salah akan mengubahnya dengan faktor yang besar, bukan 4%. Semak Mesh → Statistics: 25 node.

    3. Demo 2 · the cantilever and the mesh studyDemo 2 · cantilever dan kajian mesh

    ≈ 9 min

    The second demonstration is the cantilever of Plane Stress Part 2: 4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, fixed on the left, −10 kN on the right edge. Two things are predicted: the 2 × 2 linear run must give the hand value, 0.1306 m, and a refined quadratic mesh must approach Timoshenko beam theory, 0.1919 m.Demonstrasi kedua ialah cantilever Plane Stress Part 2: 4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, tetap di kiri, −10 kN pada tepi kanan. Dua perkara diramal: run linear 2 × 2 mesti memberi nilai tangan, 0.1306 m, dan mesh quadratic yang di-refine mesti menghampiri Timoshenko beam theory, 0.1919 m.

    Build orderUrutan membina

    1. Toolbox → Static Structural; Analysis Type 2D; Engineering Data: Isotropic Elasticity, E = 2 × 10⁸ Pa, ν = 0.33.Toolbox → Static Structural; Analysis Type 2D; Engineering Data: Isotropic Elasticity, E = 2 × 10⁸ Pa, ν = 0.33.
    2. Geometry: 4 m × 2 m surface body. In Mechanical: Geometry → 2D Behavior: Plane Stress; the body’s Thickness 0.01 m.Geometry: surface body 4 m × 2 m. Dalam Mechanical: Geometry → 2D Behavior: Plane Stress; Thickness jasad 0.01 m.
    3. Mesh: Face Meshing; Edge Sizing, 2 divisions on all four edges (Behavior: Hard); Element Order Linear → 4 elements, 9 nodes.Mesh: Face Meshing; Edge Sizing, 2 bahagian pada keempat-empat tepi (Behavior: Hard); Element Order Linear → 4 element, 9 node.
    4. Fixed Support on the left edge; Force on the right edge, Define By: Components, Y = −10 000 N.Fixed Support pada tepi kiri; Force pada tepi kanan, Define By: Components, Y = −10 000 N.
    5. Solve → Force Reaction and Moment Reaction probes on the Fixed Support first; then Directional Deformation (Y) and a probe at the top-right vertex.Solve → probe Force Reaction dan Moment Reaction pada Fixed Support dahulu; kemudian Directional Deformation (Y) dan probe di bucu kanan atas.
    ANSYS’s linear element is not the textbook Q4Linear element ANSYS bukan Q4 buku teksWith Element Control on Program Controlled, Mechanical may give PLANE182 an enhanced-strain formulation that bends far better than the textbook Q4. If your 2 × 2 linear run is much closer to 0.19 m than 0.1306 m, that is why: set Element Control to Manual with full integration to see the textbook element. Report which one you used; do not hide the difference — explaining it is the point.Dengan Element Control pada Program Controlled, Mechanical mungkin memberi PLANE182 formulasi enhanced strain yang melentur jauh lebih baik daripada Q4 buku teks. Jika run linear 2 × 2 anda jauh lebih dekat kepada 0.19 m berbanding 0.1306 m, itulah sebabnya: tetapkan Element Control kepada Manual dengan full integration untuk melihat element buku teks. Laporkan yang mana anda gunakan; jangan sembunyikan perbezaan itu — menerangkannya ialah tujuannya.

    5. Your project model: the first verified runModel projek anda: run pertama yang disahkan

    ≈ 6 min

    The last block of the session is your own structure, from the model plan of Plane Stress Part 3. The aim is not a refined answer; it is a coarse model you can trust enough to refine. That takes eight checks, in this order, stopping at the first failure.Blok terakhir sesi ialah struktur anda sendiri, daripada pelan model Plane Stress Part 3. Tujuannya bukan jawapan yang halus; tujuannya model kasar yang cukup dipercayai untuk di-refine. Itu memerlukan lapan semakan, mengikut urutan ini, berhenti pada kegagalan pertama.

    1. Units and 2D. Metric (m, kg, N); Analysis Type 2D; plane stress or plane strain stated, with the reason.Unit dan 2D. Metric (m, kg, N); Analysis Type 2D; plane stress atau plane strain dinyatakan, bersama sebabnya.
    2. Geometry. Dimensions checked against the sketch; thickness entered.Geometri. Dimensi disemak dengan lakaran; ketebalan dimasukkan.
    3. Material. E and ν (or k) with units, and where they came from.Bahan. E dan ν (atau k) dengan unit, dan dari mana nilainya.
    4. Supports. Only what is really restrained; nothing that is free is fixed.Support. Hanya yang benar-benar dikekang; tiada yang bebas ditetapkan.
    5. Loads. Tractions on edges and body forces; no forces on single vertices.Load. Traction pada tepi dan body force; tiada daya pada satu bucu.
    6. Coarse mesh. Quadratic, a few elements; it must solve.Mesh kasar. Quadratic, beberapa element; ia mesti dapat diselesaikan.
    7. Reaction. Equal to the applied load, with the right sign.Reaction. Sama dengan load yang dikenakan, dengan tanda yang betul.
    8. Hand estimate. A deflection or a stress within a factor of 2 — then, and only then, refine.Anggaran tangan. Deflection atau stress dalam faktor 2 — kemudian, dan hanya kemudian, refine.
    Steps 7 and 8 are the gateLangkah 7 dan 8 ialah pintunyaA model that fails step 7 or 8 is not refined; it is fixed. Refinement never repairs an idealisation: it converges, very precisely, to the answer of the wrong model.Model yang gagal langkah 7 atau 8 tidak di-refine; ia dibaiki. Refine tidak pernah membaiki idealisation: ia converge, dengan sangat tepat, kepada jawapan model yang salah.

    What a verified result looks like · a plate with a holeRupa keputusan yang disahkan · plat berlubang

    Predicted before Solve: Peterson’s Kt for a central hole with d/W = 0.3. Computed with a mesh refined at the hole (MAPDL example on the slides): 2.34.Diramal sebelum Solve: Kt Peterson bagi lubang tengah dengan d/W = 0.3. Dikira dengan mesh yang di-refine di lubang (contoh MAPDL dalam slides): 2.34.

    Reported as: “Kt = 2.34 against Peterson’s 2.35 (−0.4%), on a mesh whose last refinement changed it by less than 1%.” A hand-check number, a mesh that resolves the hot spot, and the comparison in one sentence: that is the standard for the project.Dilaporkan sebagai: “Kt = 2.34 against Peterson’s 2.35 (−0.4%), on a mesh whose last refinement changed it by less than 1%.” Satu nombor semakan tangan, mesh yang menyelesaikan hot spot, dan perbandingan dalam satu ayat: itulah piawai projek.

    • Common first-run problems: geometry in mm; thickness not set; a point force on a vertex; a whole edge fixed where the structure sits on a bearing; no restraint in one in-plane direction (rigid-body warning).Masalah biasa run pertama: geometri dalam mm; ketebalan tidak ditetapkan; point force pada bucu; seluruh tepi ditetapkan sedangkan struktur duduk di atas bearing; tiada kekangan dalam satu arah dalam satah (amaran rigid-body).
    • Deliverable at the end of the lab: a screenshot of the reaction probe and of the coarse-mesh result, with the hand estimate written on the model plan.Hasil di akhir makmal: tangkapan skrin probe reaction dan keputusan mesh kasar, dengan anggaran tangan ditulis pada pelan model.
    Key pointsPerkara utama
    • Eight checks in order; stop at the first failure.Lapan semakan mengikut urutan; berhenti pada kegagalan pertama.
    • Reaction = load, and a hand estimate within a factor of 2, before any refinement.Reaction = load, dan anggaran tangan dalam faktor 2, sebelum sebarang refine.
    • Report: number, check, signed difference, convergence — one sentence.Laporan: nombor, semakan, perbezaan bertanda, convergence — satu ayat.
    Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

    Your coarse project model has the right reaction, but its deflection is 3.1 mm where your hand estimate is 0.9 mm. Next step?Model projek kasar anda mempunyai reaction yang betul, tetapi deflection-nya 3.1 mm sedangkan anggaran tangan anda 0.9 mm. Langkah seterusnya?

    A factor of 3.4 is outside the factor-of-2 gate. The reaction is right, so the loads are; the difference lies in stiffness or restraint — or in the hand estimate itself, which then needs fixing too. Refinement would converge to the same wrong model.Faktor 3.4 berada di luar pintu faktor 2. Reaction betul, jadi load betul; perbezaan terletak pada kekakuan atau kekangan — atau pada anggaran tangan itu sendiri, yang kemudiannya perlu dibaiki juga. Refine akan converge kepada model salah yang sama.

    6. Verification, validation and the hybrid projectVerification, validation dan projek hibrid

    ≈ 9 min

    Two different questions hide behind “is the model right?”. Asking them separately is what turns a colour plot into evidence.Dua soalan yang berbeza tersembunyi di sebalik “betulkah model ini?”. Bertanya kedua-duanya secara berasingan itulah yang menukar contour plot kepada bukti.

    Verification — solving the equations rightVerification — menyelesaikan persamaan dengan betulDoes the computer solve the mathematical model correctly? Checked against things that are exact for that model: a hand calculation on one element, a patch test, convergence to a known analytical solution, equilibrium of the reactions, an independent second code.Adakah komputer menyelesaikan model matematik dengan betul? Disemak dengan perkara yang tepat bagi model itu: pengiraan tangan pada satu element, patch test, convergence kepada penyelesaian analitikal yang diketahui, keseimbangan reaction, kod kedua yang bebas.
    Validation — solving the right equationsValidation — menyelesaikan persamaan yang betulDoes the mathematical model represent the real structure — plane stress or not, linear elastic or not, these supports or others? Only measurements can answer it: a load test, strain gauges, monitoring data. Without them, say plainly what the model cannot tell you.Adakah model matematik mewakili struktur sebenar — plane stress atau tidak, linear elastic atau tidak, support ini atau yang lain? Hanya pengukuran boleh menjawabnya: ujian beban, strain gauge, data pemantauan. Tanpanya, nyatakan dengan jelas apa yang model tidak dapat beritahu.

    The two demonstrations of this session were verification: ANSYS against hand calculations and textbook solutions. Agreement there says the software solves the idealised plate correctly; it cannot say that the idealisation was right — the four wrong models solved their own equations perfectly.Dua demonstrasi sesi ini ialah verification: ANSYS berbanding pengiraan tangan dan penyelesaian buku teks. Persetujuan di situ menunjukkan perisian menyelesaikan plat yang diidealkan dengan betul; ia tidak boleh menunjukkan bahawa idealisation itu betul — empat model yang salah menyelesaikan persamaan masing-masing dengan sempurna.

    The hybrid project: ANSYS first, your own tool as the independent checkProjek hibrid: ANSYS dahulu, alat anda sendiri sebagai semakan bebas

    In the project, ANSYS is the primary analysis. Each group also builds a small solver of its own — written with generative AI if you wish (“vibe coding”), deployed on GitHub — as an independent check of the ANSYS model. Two implementations that agree are stronger evidence than either alone; when they disagree, the difference is explained, never averaged away. The tool is only trusted after it passes the stage gates below, in order.Dalam projek, ANSYS ialah analisis utama. Setiap kumpulan juga membina solver kecil sendiri — ditulis dengan generative AI jika mahu (“vibe coding”), di-deploy di GitHub — sebagai semakan bebas bagi model ANSYS. Dua pelaksanaan yang sepakat ialah bukti yang lebih kuat daripada salah satunya sahaja; apabila tidak sepakat, perbezaannya diterangkan, tidak sekali-kali dipuratakan. Alat itu hanya dipercayai selepas melepasi stage gate di bawah, mengikut urutan.

    GateGateWhat must be shownApa yang mesti ditunjukkanWhat it proves — and what it does notApa yang dibuktikan — dan apa yang tidak
    0Specification and validation plan, written before any code: the problem, the idealisation, the quantities of interest, the checks and their tolerances.Spesifikasi dan pelan validation, ditulis sebelum sebarang kod: masalah, idealisation, kuantiti yang dikehendaki, semakan dan toleransinya.That the group knows what “right” will mean. Nothing about the code yet.Bahawa kumpulan tahu apa maksud “betul”. Belum ada apa-apa tentang kod.
    1Core solver: one element against a hand calculation (an entry of [k]); the patch test, exact to round-off; ΣR equal to the physical load.Core solver: satu element berbanding pengiraan tangan (satu entri [k]); patch test, tepat hingga round-off; ΣR sama dengan load fizikal.Element, assembly, loads and supports are consistent. Not that bending is right (Example 4).Element, assembly, load dan support konsisten. Bukan bahawa bending betul (Contoh 4).
    2Verification against a known solution: convergence to Timoshenko (cantilever) or Kirsch (plate with a hole, Kt → 3) with the observed order.Verification berbanding penyelesaian yang diketahui: convergence kepada Timoshenko (cantilever) atau Kirsch (plat berlubang, Kt → 3) dengan observed order.The equations are solved right. Not that they are the right equations.Persamaan diselesaikan dengan betul. Bukan bahawa ia persamaan yang betul.
    3ANSYS cross-check on the project structure: same idealisation, comparable mesh; every difference above the tolerance explained (element formulation, load application, averaging).Semakan silang ANSYS pada struktur projek: idealisation yang sama, mesh yang setanding; setiap perbezaan melebihi toleransi diterangkan (formulasi element, cara load dikenakan, averaging).Two independent implementations agree. Not that the model matches the real structure.Dua pelaksanaan bebas sepakat. Bukan bahawa model sepadan dengan struktur sebenar.
    4UI and deployment: the tool runs from the group’s GitHub repository (GitHub Pages), with a README that states what it verifies and its limits.UI dan deployment: alat berjalan dari repository GitHub kumpulan (GitHub Pages), dengan README yang menyatakan apa yang disahkan dan hadnya.Others can run and check the tool.Orang lain boleh menjalankan dan menyemak alat itu.
    5Individual viva and demonstration: each member runs a gate live and explains the code and the numbers behind it.Viva dan demonstrasi individu: setiap ahli menjalankan satu gate secara langsung dan menerangkan kod serta nombor di sebaliknya.The understanding is the student’s, not the AI’s.Kefahaman itu milik pelajar, bukan AI.
    What the gates catch (Example 4)Apa yang ditangkap oleh gate (Contoh 4)A load bug that gives every edge node σ0tb instead of σ0tb/2 still balances its own load vector: ΣR must be compared with the physical load, σ0tH. A shear-modulus bug (Ē instead of Ē(1 − ν)/2) passes a tension patch test exactly, because the shear strain is zero there, and is caught only at Gate 2: the Q8 16 × 8 cantilever tip becomes 0.1696 m, 11.6% below Timoshenko.Pepijat load yang memberi setiap node tepi σ0tb dan bukannya σ0tb/2 masih mengimbangi vektor load-nya sendiri: ΣR mesti dibandingkan dengan load fizikal, σ0tH. Pepijat shear modulus (Ē dan bukannya Ē(1 − ν)/2) melepasi patch test tegangan dengan tepat, kerana shear strain sifar di situ, dan hanya ditangkap di Gate 2: tip cantilever Q8 16 × 8 menjadi 0.1696 m, 11.6% di bawah Timoshenko.

    Key pointsPerkara utama
    • Verification: the equations solved right (hand check, patch test, convergence, a second code). Validation: the right equations (measurements).Verification: persamaan diselesaikan dengan betul (semakan tangan, patch test, convergence, kod kedua). Validation: persamaan yang betul (pengukuran).
    • Gates 0–5: plan → core solver → known solution → ANSYS cross-check → deploy → viva. In order; no skipping.Gate 0–5: pelan → core solver → penyelesaian diketahui → semakan silang ANSYS → deploy → viva. Mengikut urutan; tiada lompatan.
    • Marks: 35 verification and cross-check · 20 interpretation · 25 viva and demo · 10 UI, deploy, repository · 10 GenAI log and reflection.Markah: 35 verification dan semakan silang · 20 tafsiran · 25 viva dan demo · 10 UI, deploy, repository · 10 log GenAI dan refleksi.
    Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

    Your group’s solver reproduces the tension patch test to 10−17 m. Can you conclude that it is correct?Solver kumpulan anda menghasilkan semula patch test tegangan hingga 10−17 m. Bolehkah anda simpulkan bahawa ia betul?

    In uniform tension σxy = 0, so the shear row of [E] is never exercised: with Ē in place of Ē(1 − ν)/2 the patch is still exact, while the cantilever comes out 11.6% stiff. Each gate proves something specific; together they build the case. ANSYS would agree on the patch too — for the same reason.Dalam tegangan seragam σxy = 0, jadi baris shear [E] tidak pernah diuji: dengan Ē menggantikan Ē(1 − ν)/2 patch masih tepat, manakala cantilever menjadi 11.6% terlalu kaku. Setiap gate membuktikan sesuatu yang khusus; bersama-sama ia membina hujah. ANSYS juga akan sepakat pada patch itu — atas sebab yang sama.

    How this part is assessedBagaimana bahagian ini dinilai

    This part is mostly assessed through the project. In a test, software appears as given output to be judged: convert the inputs, predict what a correct run must show, check a reaction or a mesh study, name a wrong model from its numbers. The model answers below are in that form, with a suggested marking scheme; the examiner’s own scheme may differ.Bahagian ini kebanyakannya dinilai melalui projek. Dalam ujian, perisian muncul sebagai output yang diberi untuk dinilai: tukar input, ramal apa yang mesti ditunjukkan oleh run yang betul, semak reaction atau kajian mesh, namakan model yang salah daripada nombornya. Jawapan model di bawah dalam bentuk itu, dengan skema pemarkahan cadangan; skema pemeriksa sendiri mungkin berbeza.

    Example 1 · The plate in Workbench: predict the hand mesh, check the heat balance, judge the refinementContoh 1 · Plat dalam Workbench: ramal mesh tangan, semak keseimbangan haba, nilai refine

    Exam typeJenis soalan predict a software run; energy checkUnitsUnit W, m, °CSourceSumber text §2.3; Heat Transfer Part 215 marksmarkah
    QuestionSoalanThe 1 m square plate of the text (k = 300 W m−1 K−1, 600 W m−3 generated, 0 °C on the top and left edges, the other edges insulated, t = 1 m) is set up in Steady-State Thermal with four linear elements (Element Size 0.5 m). (a) Predict, by hand, the temperatures the run must show at the free nodes. (b) What must the reactions on the two Temperature conditions add up to, and why? (c) Runs with 4 × 4, 8 × 8 and 16 × 16 elements give 0.5968, 0.5912 and 0.5898 °C at the corner; the converged value is 0.5897 °C. Judge the 2 × 2 run.Plat segi empat sama 1 m dalam teks (k = 300 W m−1 K−1, 600 W m−3 dijana, 0 °C pada tepi atas dan kiri, tepi lain insulated, t = 1 m) disediakan dalam Steady-State Thermal dengan empat linear element (Element Size 0.5 m). (a) Ramal, dengan tangan, suhu yang mesti ditunjukkan oleh run pada node bebas. (b) Berapakah jumlah reaction pada dua keadaan Temperature, dan mengapa? (c) Run dengan 4 × 4, 8 × 8 dan 16 × 16 element memberi 0.5968, 0.5912 dan 0.5898 °C di bucu; nilai converge ialah 0.5897 °C. Nilai run 2 × 2.

    Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. Heat is generated everywhere and can leave only through the cold top and left edges, so the hottest point is the corner farthest from both, the bottom-right. The plate is symmetric about the diagonal from (0, 1) to (1, 0): the bottom mid-edge and the right mid-edge must have the same temperature.Haba dijana di semua tempat dan hanya boleh keluar melalui tepi atas dan kiri yang sejuk, jadi titik paling panas ialah bucu paling jauh dari kedua-duanya, iaitu kanan bawah. Plat simetri terhadap pepenjuru dari (0, 1) ke (1, 0): tengah tepi bawah dan tengah tepi kanan mesti mempunyai suhu yang sama.

    Plan. [k] for a = b = 0.5 → {q} → assemble the free rows (nodes 2, 3, 5, 6) → T6 = T2 → solve → heat balance → percentages.

    Step 1 (a) Element matrix and loads(a) Matrix element dan load[4]

    Check. Each row of [k] adds up to zero (a uniform temperature carries no heat), and the four element loads add up to Q a b t = 150 W.

    Step 2 (a) The free equations(a) Persamaan bebas[4]

    Nodes 1, 4, 7, 8, 9 are at 0 °C, so only the rows and columns of nodes 2, 3, 5, 6 remain:Node 1, 4, 7, 8, 9 pada 0 °C, jadi hanya baris dan lajur node 2, 3, 5, 6 yang tinggal:

    With T6 = T2 (symmetry), the first three rows becomeDengan T6 = T2 (simetri), tiga baris pertama menjadi

    Check. Row 2: 300(0.48214) − 50(0.62143) − 100(0.38571) = 75.00.

    Answer. (a) The run must show T3 = 0.6214 °C at the corner, 0.4821 °C at both mid-edges and 0.3857 °C at the centre — the text’s (2.55), to four decimals.

    Step 3 (b) The heat balance(b) Keseimbangan haba[3]

    The reactions are the struck rows [K]{T} − {R} at the fixed nodes, the heat removed there:Reaction ialah baris yang dibuang [K]{T} − {R} pada node tetap, haba yang dikeluarkan di situ:

    Answer. (b) −600 W in total (with t = 1 m): in a steady state all the heat generated, 600 × 1 × 1 W, must leave through the cold edges, on any mesh.

    Step 4 (c) The refinement(c) Refine[4]

    Answer. (c) The 2 × 2 run over-predicts the peak by 5.4%; the error falls by about 4 to 5 times per halving, and 16 × 16 is within 0.02%.
    InterpretationTafsiranThe linear 2 × 2 run is a test of the model, not of the physics: it must reproduce the hand calculation exactly, because it is the same element with the same consistent loads. If it does not, the mesh or the element order is not what you think. The heat balance is the thermal version of the reaction check — exact on any mesh, so it checks the conditions and the source, not the accuracy. Accuracy comes only from the refinement, and here it is quick: the error drops roughly as h², so 8 × 8 is already within 0.3%.Run linear 2 × 2 menguji model, bukan fizik: ia mesti menghasilkan semula pengiraan tangan dengan tepat, kerana ia element yang sama dengan consistent load yang sama. Jika tidak, mesh atau element order bukan seperti yang anda sangka. Keseimbangan haba ialah versi thermal bagi semakan reaction — tepat pada sebarang mesh, jadi ia menyemak keadaan sempadan dan sumber, bukan ketepatan. Ketepatan hanya datang daripada refine, dan di sini ia cepat: ralat menurun lebih kurang sebagai h², jadi 8 × 8 sudah dalam 0.3%.

    Example 2 · The cantilever in Workbench: inputs, reactions, the convergence table and the reported valueContoh 2 · Cantilever dalam Workbench: input, reaction, convergence table dan nilai yang dilaporkan

    Exam typeJenis soalan set up a run and judge a mesh studyUnitsUnit N, mSourceSumber text §3.4; Plane Stress Parts 2–320 marksmarkah
    QuestionSoalanThe text’s cantilever (4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33, fixed on the left, qy = −5 kN m−1 on the right edge) is to be run in Static Structural. (a) Give the Force or Pressure, E and the Edge Sizing that reproduce the 2 × 2 hand mesh. (b) What must the Force and Moment Reaction probes show? (c) Quadratic meshes give the tip deflections below: compute the changes and choose the mesh to report at a 1% tolerance. (d) Compare with Timoshenko beam theory and estimate the converged value. (e) Linear elements give 0.1824 m (8 × 4) and 0.1886 m (16 × 8). Comment.Cantilever teks (4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33, tetap di kiri, qy = −5 kN m−1 pada tepi kanan) akan di-run dalam Static Structural. (a) Beri Force atau Pressure, E dan Edge Sizing yang menghasilkan semula mesh tangan 2 × 2. (b) Apa yang mesti ditunjukkan oleh probe Force dan Moment Reaction? (c) Mesh quadratic memberi tip deflection di bawah: kira perubahan dan pilih mesh untuk dilaporkan pada toleransi 1%. (d) Bandingkan dengan Timoshenko beam theory dan anggarkan nilai converge. (e) Linear element memberi 0.1824 m (8 × 4) dan 0.1886 m (16 × 8). Ulas.
    quadratic meshmesh quadratic2 × 14 × 28 × 416 × 8
    |vtip| (m)0.177960.188460.190590.19125
    Values from the course Q8 solver; a PLANE183 run should be within about 1% of them.Nilai daripada solver Q8 kursus; run PLANE183 patut berada dalam kira-kira 1% daripadanya.

    Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. The end load bends the cantilever down and every section carries 10 kN of shear. The supports must carry the load and its moment about the fixed edge whatever the mesh. The deflection rises towards the Timoshenko value as the mesh is refined, quickly with quadratic elements, slowly with linear ones.Load hujung melentur cantilever ke bawah dan setiap keratan membawa shear 10 kN. Support mesti membawa load dan momennya terhadap tepi tetap tanpa mengira mesh. Deflection naik ke arah nilai Timoshenko apabila mesh di-refine, cepat dengan quadratic element, perlahan dengan linear element.

    Plan. Convert → reactions from statics → changes → tolerance → Timoshenko → Richardson → linear against quadratic.

    Step 1 (a) Inputs(a) Input[3]

    Check. −500 × 10³ × (2 × 0.01) = −10 000 N: the Pressure gives the Force back.

    Step 2 (b) Reactions(b) Reaction[3]

    Answer. (b) Force Reaction X = 0, Y = +10 000 N; Moment Reaction 40 000 N m — on every mesh and for either element order.

    Step 3 (c) The convergence table(c) Convergence table[4]

    Answer. (c) Report the 8 × 4 mesh (or finer): the refinement after it changed the deflection by 0.35%, below 1%.

    Step 4 (d) Independent check and the converged value(d) Semakan bebas dan nilai converge[6]

    Check. The course Q8 32 × 16 mesh gives 0.19151 m, 0.02% from the extrapolated 0.19155 m.

    Answer. (d) 8 × 4 is 0.69% and 16 × 8 0.35% below Timoshenko’s 0.1919 m; the extrapolated plane-stress value is 0.1916 m, about 0.2% below beam theory, which is a different model (κ = 5/6, no restraint of the Poisson contraction at the support).

    Step 5 (e) Linear elements(e) Linear element[4]

    Answer. (e) The linear element is 4.3% stiffer on the 8 × 4 mesh and needs 16 × 8 to come within 2% of beam theory: shear locking. Expect an enhanced-strain PLANE182 to do better than these textbook-Q4 values; say which formulation was used.
    InterpretationTafsiranThree numbers carry the result: the reaction (inputs right), the change between the last two meshes (discretisation small enough) and the difference from Timoshenko (an independent model agrees). The report sentence follows directly: “The 8 × 4 quadratic mesh gives a tip deflection of 0.1906 m; the next refinement changed it by 0.35%, and it lies 0.7% below Timoshenko beam theory; the reactions are 10.0 kN and 40.0 kN m.” Richardson adds an error estimate without a finer mesh, and the 32 × 16 result confirms it to 0.02%. The remaining 0.2% between the converged plate and beam theory is a modelling difference, not a mesh error — which is why beam theory is a check, not the truth.Tiga nombor membawa keputusan: reaction (input betul), perubahan antara dua mesh terakhir (discretisation cukup kecil) dan perbezaan daripada Timoshenko (model bebas sepakat). Ayat laporan terus terhasil: “The 8 × 4 quadratic mesh gives a tip deflection of 0.1906 m; the next refinement changed it by 0.35%, and it lies 0.7% below Timoshenko beam theory; the reactions are 10.0 kN and 40.0 kN m.” Richardson menambah anggaran ralat tanpa mesh yang lebih halus, dan keputusan 32 × 16 mengesahkannya hingga 0.02%. Baki 0.2% antara plat yang converge dan beam theory ialah perbezaan pemodelan, bukan ralat mesh — sebab itulah beam theory ialah semakan, bukan kebenaran.

    Example 3 · Four runs of the cantilever, three of them wrong: diagnose from the numbersContoh 3 · Empat run cantilever, tiga daripadanya salah: diagnosis daripada nombor

    Exam typeJenis soalan diagnose software outputUnitsUnit N, m, kN m⁻²SourceSumber W14 Activity 4; Cantilever Explorer12 marksmarkah
    QuestionSoalanFour quadratic 32 × 16 runs of the text’s cantilever give the results below; the correct model gives a tip deflection of 0.1915 m and, in the element under the right edge’s top corner, σvM = 523 kN m−2. For each run, name the mistake (plane strain, a vertex force, a support that fixes only v, a wrong thickness) or say it is correct, and give the evidence.Empat run quadratic 32 × 16 bagi cantilever teks memberi keputusan di bawah; model yang betul memberi tip deflection 0.1915 m dan, dalam element di bawah bucu atas tepi kanan, σvM = 523 kN m−2. Bagi setiap run, namakan kesilapannya (plane strain, daya pada bucu, support yang hanya menetapkan v, ketebalan yang salah) atau nyatakan ia betul, dan beri buktinya.
    RunRunRy (N)tip v (m)tip v (m)other outputoutput lain
    A+10 000−0.001915——
    B+10 000−0.2298mid-depth of the free end −0.1875 m; σvM 5353 kN m−2 under the loadtengah kedalaman hujung bebas −0.1875 m; σvM 5353 kN m−2 di bawah load
    C+10 000−0.1722σzz listed among the resultsσzz disenaraikan dalam keputusan
    D+10 000−0.1915no warnings; σvM 523 kN m−2 in the corner elementtiada amaran; σvM 523 kN m−2 dalam element bucu

    Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. Every run has the right reaction, so the loads and supports carry 10 kN: the differences are in the idealisation. Each idealisation error scales the response in its own way — the thickness divides everything, plane strain stiffens by about 1 − ν², a point load disturbs only its neighbourhood.Setiap run mempunyai reaction yang betul, jadi load dan support membawa 10 kN: perbezaannya terletak pada idealisation. Setiap ralat idealisation menskala respons dengan caranya sendiri — ketebalan membahagi segalanya, plane strain mengakukan kira-kira 1 − ν², point load hanya mengganggu kawasan sekitarnya.

    Plan. Reaction → ratio to the correct deflection → where the change is (everywhere or local) → the extra output.

    Step 1 Ratios to the correct modelNisbah kepada model yang betul[4]

    Step 2 A and CA dan C[3]

    A is a clean factor of 0.0100 everywhere: v ∝ 1/t, so the thickness is 1 m instead of 0.01 m. C is 10% stiffer, close to 1 − ν², and lists σzz = ν(σxx + σyy), which exists only in plane strain.A ialah faktor 0.0100 yang tepat di semua tempat: v ∝ 1/t, jadi ketebalan 1 m dan bukannya 0.01 m. C 10% lebih kaku, hampir 1 − ν², dan menyenaraikan σzz = ν(σxx + σyy), yang hanya wujud dalam plane strain.

    Answer. A: thickness. C: plane strain.

    Step 3 B and DB dan D[3]

    B is 20% too flexible at the loaded vertex but within 0.7% at mid-depth, and the stress under the load is ten times the correct value: a local disturbance, the signature of a point force (St-Venant). D matches the correct model in deflection and stress, with no warning.B 20% terlalu fleksibel pada bucu yang dibebankan tetapi dalam 0.7% di tengah kedalaman, dan stress di bawah load sepuluh kali nilai yang betul: gangguan setempat, tanda point force (St-Venant). D sepadan dengan model yang betul dalam deflection dan stress, tanpa amaran.

    Answer. B: a force on the top-right vertex. D: correct. The fourth mistake, a support fixing only v, is not among them: it would have produced a rigid-body warning.

    Step 4 Why the reaction did not helpMengapa reaction tidak membantu[2]

    Equilibrium of the whole plate fixes Ry = 10 000 N for any stiffness, thickness or idealisation. It catches a wrong load or a missing support, never a wrong model.Keseimbangan seluruh plat menetapkan Ry = 10 000 N bagi sebarang kekakuan, ketebalan atau idealisation. Ia menangkap load yang salah atau support yang tertinggal, tidak sekali-kali model yang salah.

    InterpretationTafsiranA modelling mistake leaves a signature: a clean factor (thickness, units), a factor tied to a material constant (1 − ν² for plane strain), a local disturbance (a point load), or a warning (a mechanism). Reading it needs a prediction to compare against — the correct deflection here, a hand estimate in the project. That is why the reaction is the first check but never the last.Kesilapan pemodelan meninggalkan tanda: faktor yang tepat (ketebalan, unit), faktor yang terikat pada pemalar bahan (1 − ν² bagi plane strain), gangguan setempat (point load), atau amaran (mekanisme). Membacanya memerlukan ramalan untuk dibandingkan — deflection yang betul di sini, anggaran tangan dalam projek. Sebab itulah reaction ialah semakan pertama tetapi tidak pernah yang terakhir.

    Example 4 · Gate 1 for your own solver: one element, the patch test and the reactions — and what they missContoh 4 · Gate 1 bagi solver anda sendiri: satu element, patch test dan reaction — dan apa yang terlepas

    Exam typeJenis soalan verify a code; explain what a check provesUnitsUnit N, mSourceSumber hybrid project, Gates 1–215 marksmarkah
    QuestionSoalanA group’s plane-stress solver (4-node rectangles) is at Gate 1. (a) For one element with a = 2 m, b = 1 m, t = 0.01 m, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33, what must k11 be? (b) The patch of the figure (E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.3, t = 0.01 m) is pulled by σ0 = 1000 kN m−2 on its right edge. Give the nodal loads, the exact displacements, the stresses and the reaction that a correct solver must reproduce. (c) Two bugs are planted: the edge nodes receive σ0tb instead of σ0tb/2, and the shear entry of [E] is Ē instead of Ē(1 − ν)/2. Which Gate 1 check catches each, and what catches the other?Solver plane stress satu kumpulan (segi empat tepat 4-node) berada di Gate 1. (a) Bagi satu element dengan a = 2 m, b = 1 m, t = 0.01 m, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33, berapakah k11 yang sepatutnya? (b) Patch dalam rajah (E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.3, t = 0.01 m) ditarik oleh σ0 = 1000 kN m−2 pada tepi kanannya. Beri nodal load, displacement tepat, stress dan reaction yang mesti dihasilkan semula oleh solver yang betul. (c) Dua pepijat ditanam: node tepi menerima σ0tb dan bukannya σ0tb/2, dan entri shear [E] ialah Ē dan bukannya Ē(1 − ν)/2. Semakan Gate 1 mana yang menangkap setiap satu, dan apa yang menangkap yang lain?

    Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. A uniform tension in a plate gives a constant stress, a displacement linear in x and y, and no shear. Bilinear elements contain linear fields exactly, so a consistent solver must reproduce that state on any mesh, however uneven — to round-off, not approximately. Anything else is a bug.Tegangan seragam dalam plat memberi stress malar, displacement linear dalam x dan y, dan tiada shear. Element bilinear mengandungi field linear dengan tepat, jadi solver yang konsisten mesti menghasilkan semula keadaan itu pada sebarang mesh, betapa tidak sekata sekalipun — hingga round-off, bukan lebih kurang. Selain itu ialah pepijat.

    Plan. k11 closed form → edge loads → exact field → stresses → ΣR against σ0tH → each bug against each check.

    Step 1 (a) One element against the hand calculation(a) Satu element berbanding pengiraan tangan[3]

    Answer. (a) k11 = 0.8753 × 10⁶ N m−1 — the s1 = 0.875 of the text’s cantilever. Compare the whole first row, not one entry: it must also add up to zero in u.

    Step 2 (b) Loads and the exact solution(b) Load dan penyelesaian tepat[4]

    Step 3 (b) Stresses and reactions(b) Stress dan reaction[3]

    σxx = 1000, σyy = 0, σxy = 0 kN m−2 at every point of every element — centroid and corners alike. The course element routine, assembled on this patch, reproduces u and v to 10−17 m and these stresses exactly.σxx = 1000, σyy = 0, σxy = 0 kN m−2 pada setiap titik setiap element — centroid dan bucu sama sahaja. Rutin element kursus, di-assemble pada patch ini, menghasilkan semula u dan v hingga 10−17 m dan stress ini dengan tepat.

    Answer. (b) Loads 2000, 5000, 3000 N; u = 0.0100 m on the right edge, v = −0.0015 m on the top; σ = {1000, 0, 0} kN m−2 everywhere; ΣRx = −10 000 N.

    Step 4 (c) The two bugs(c) Dua pepijat[5]

    The load bug doubles every displacement and its reactions still balance its own load vector, −20 000 N: ΣR catches it only when compared with the physical load σ0tH = 10 000 N, and the patch’s exact u catches it too. The shear bug is invisible here, because σxy = 0 in uniform tension; it is caught at Gate 2, where the cantilever, which carries shear, comes out 11.6% too stiff against Timoshenko.Pepijat load menggandakan setiap displacement dan reaction-nya masih mengimbangi vektor load-nya sendiri, −20 000 N: ΣR hanya menangkapnya apabila dibandingkan dengan load fizikal σ0tH = 10 000 N, dan u tepat patch juga menangkapnya. Pepijat shear tidak kelihatan di sini, kerana σxy = 0 dalam tegangan seragam; ia ditangkap di Gate 2, di mana cantilever, yang membawa shear, menjadi 11.6% terlalu kaku berbanding Timoshenko.

    Answer. (c) Load bug: the patch displacements and ΣR against σ0tH (Gate 1). Shear bug: passes Gate 1; caught by the Timoshenko convergence of Gate 2.
    InterpretationTafsiranEach gate proves one thing. One element against the closed form checks the integration of [k]; the patch test checks that element, assembly, loads and supports reproduce a constant-stress state exactly; ΣR against the physical load checks the load bookkeeping. None of them exercises every term — a tension patch never touches the shear modulus — which is why the gates come in sequence and why a bending problem with a known answer follows. With an AI-written solver this matters more, not less: the code can look right and pass the checks it happens to exercise. The GenAI log records which gate caught which error.Setiap gate membuktikan satu perkara. Satu element berbanding closed form menyemak integration [k]; patch test menyemak bahawa element, assembly, load dan support menghasilkan semula keadaan stress malar dengan tepat; ΣR berbanding load fizikal menyemak catatan load. Tiada satu pun yang menguji setiap term — patch tegangan tidak pernah menyentuh shear modulus — sebab itulah gate datang secara berurutan dan masalah bending dengan jawapan yang diketahui menyusul. Dengan solver yang ditulis oleh AI, ini lebih penting, bukan kurang: kod boleh kelihatan betul dan lulus semakan yang kebetulan diujinya. Log GenAI merekod gate mana yang menangkap ralat mana.

    A student writes the input sheet for the text’s cantilever (4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, qy = −5 kN m−1 on the right edge) before building it in Workbench. One line contains the slip. Which one?Seorang pelajar menulis helaian input bagi cantilever teks (4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, qy = −5 kN m−1 pada tepi kanan) sebelum membinanya dalam Workbench. Satu baris mengandungi kesilapan. Yang mana?

    Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

    Line 4: the lever arm of the end load about the support is the length, 4 m, not the depth: M = 10 000 × 4 = 40 000 N m. With 20 000 N m as the expectation, a correct run would look wrong — or a wrong one right. The check that catches it: the moment is P × L for a cantilever, the value the hand calculation of Plane Stress Part 2 gave.Baris 4: lengan momen load hujung terhadap support ialah panjang, 4 m, bukan kedalaman: M = 10 000 × 4 = 40 000 N m. Dengan 20 000 N m sebagai jangkaan, run yang betul akan kelihatan salah — atau yang salah kelihatan betul. Semakan yang menangkapnya: momen ialah P × L bagi cantilever, nilai yang diberi oleh pengiraan tangan Plane Stress Part 2.

    Show the codeTunjuk kod · fe_plane_stress.py · 323 linesbaris
    """
SEAA 4243 Finite Element Method - plane stress with 4-node and 8-node elements
==============================================================================

Companion code for the Cantilever and Stress Recovery Explorers (Plane Stress).
It follows the course's steps in the text's notation (Mohd Yassin et al.,
MSNM 2020, Chapter 3):

    [E]   3 x 3 material matrix, plane stress or plane strain       text (3.10)
    [B]   strains from nodal displacements, {eps} = [d]^T[N]{u}     weak form (3.31)-(3.38)
    [k]   = t * integral [B]^T [E] [B] dA                          closed form (3.42);
          here by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 points for the 4-node
          element, 3 x 3 for the 8-node), which reproduces (3.42)
    loads a uniform traction on the free end becomes consistent nodal
          loads: q b/2 to each node (4-node, (3.45)); q b/6, 2q b/3,
          q b/6 (8-node, (3.51))
    solve assemble (3.46), strike the fixed edge's rows and columns
          (3.48), solve (3.49); reactions from the struck rows;
          stresses {sigma} = [E][B]{u} at any point; principal stresses,
          von Mises, and nodal averaging as in ANSYS.

The built-in problem is the text's cantilever: a plate 4 m x 2 m,
t = 0.01 m, E = 200e6 N/m2, nu = 0.33, fixed at x = 0, loaded at x = 4 by a
uniform downward traction of 5000 N per metre of edge (P = 10 kN in total).
The functions take any L, H, mesh, material, thickness and load.

Mesh and numbering
    4-node: nodes left to right, then bottom to top (the text's 2 x 2 mesh:
    nodes 1-3 along the bottom). dof 2i-1 = u_i, dof 2i = v_i (1-based).
    8-node: corner and mid-side nodes are numbered in the order they are
    created; use node_at(res, x, y) to find a node.

Units
    Any consistent set. The example uses N and m, so stresses come out in
    N/m2 (divide by 1e3 for kN/m2). The traction q is force per unit length
    of the loaded edge (N/m), the thickness already included.

Run
    python fe_plane_stress.py
        reproduces the 2 x 2 cantilever (tip deflection, reactions, stresses
        at (3.5, 1.3)), the convergence of the 4- and 8-node meshes against
        Timoshenko beam theory, and the growth of the stress at the fixed
        corner; saves a von Mises contour plot if matplotlib is installed.

Use for your own model
    from fe_plane_stress import solve_cantilever, stress_at, principal, von_mises
    res = solve_cantilever(L=4, H=2, Nx=8, Ny=4, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000, nen=8)
    s = stress_at(res, 2.0, 1.3)        # (sxx, syy, sxy)

A hand calculation is still a hand calculation: use this script to check your
matrices and numbers, and to run the mesh study a project needs.
Dense numpy solver: fine up to a few thousand degrees of freedom.

Requires Python 3.8+ and numpy; matplotlib only for the plot.
Course SEAA 4243, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
Code: MIT licence.
"""
import numpy as np


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Material
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def E_matrix(E, nu, plane="stress"):
    """[E] of text (3.10) for plane stress; plane strain when plane = "strain"."""
    if plane == "stress":
        c = E / (1 - nu ** 2)
        return c * np.array([[1, nu, 0], [nu, 1, 0], [0, 0, (1 - nu) / 2]])
    c = E / ((1 + nu) * (1 - 2 * nu))
    return c * np.array([[1 - nu, nu, 0], [nu, 1 - nu, 0], [0, 0, (1 - 2 * nu) / 2]])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape functions in natural coordinates xi, eta in [-1, 1]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XI = np.array([-1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0, -1], dtype=float)
ETA = np.array([-1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0], dtype=float)


def shape(nen, xi, eta):
    """N (nen,) and dN/dxi, dN/deta (2, nen) of the 4-node or 8-node element."""
    if nen == 4:
        N = 0.25 * (1 + XI[:4] * xi) * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta)
        dN = np.vstack([0.25 * XI[:4] * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta), 0.25 * ETA[:4] * (1 + XI[:4] * xi)])
        return N, dN
    N = np.zeros(8); dN = np.zeros((2, 8))
    for i in range(4):
        cx, cy = XI[i], ETA[i]
        N[i] = 0.25 * (1 + cx * xi) * (1 + cy * eta) * (cx * xi + cy * eta - 1)
        dN[0, i] = 0.25 * cx * (1 + cy * eta) * (2 * cx * xi + cy * eta)
        dN[1, i] = 0.25 * cy * (1 + cx * xi) * (cx * xi + 2 * cy * eta)
    N[4] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 - eta); dN[:, 4] = [-xi * (1 - eta), -0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[5] = 0.5 * (1 + xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 5] = [0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 + xi)]
    N[6] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 + eta); dN[:, 6] = [-xi * (1 + eta), 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[7] = 0.5 * (1 - xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 7] = [-0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 - xi)]
    return N, dN


def B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta):
    """[B] (3 x 2nen) of an a x b rectangle at (xi, eta): rows exx, eyy, gamma_xy."""
    _, dN = shape(nen, xi, eta)
    dx, dy = dN[0] * 2 / a, dN[1] * 2 / b
    B = np.zeros((3, 2 * nen))
    B[0, 0::2] = dx
    B[1, 1::2] = dy
    B[2, 0::2] = dy
    B[2, 1::2] = dx
    return B


def element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t):
    """[k] = t * integral [B]^T[E][B] dA by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 for Q4, 3 x 3 for Q8)."""
    g, w = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(2 if nen == 4 else 3)
    k = np.zeros((2 * nen, 2 * nen))
    for xi, wi in zip(g, w):
        for eta, wj in zip(g, w):
            B = B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta)
            k += t * (a / 2) * (b / 2) * wi * wj * B.T @ Em @ B
    return k


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mesh
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny):
    a, b = L / Nx, H / Ny
    if nen == 4:
        nodes = np.array([(i * a, j * b) for j in range(Ny + 1) for i in range(Nx + 1)], dtype=float)
        conn = [[j * (Nx + 1) + i, j * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i]
                for j in range(Ny) for i in range(Nx)]
        return a, b, nodes, np.array(conn, dtype=int)
    ids, nodes = {}, []
    def node(x, y):
        key = (round(x, 9), round(y, 9))
        if key not in ids:
            ids[key] = len(nodes); nodes.append((x, y))
        return ids[key]
    conn = []
    for j in range(Ny):
        for i in range(Nx):
            x0, y0 = i * a, j * b
            conn.append([node(x0, y0), node(x0 + a, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b),
                         node(x0 + a / 2, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b / 2), node(x0 + a / 2, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b / 2)])
    return a, b, np.array(nodes, dtype=float), np.array(conn, dtype=int)


def dofs_of(c):
    return np.ravel([[2 * n, 2 * n + 1] for n in c])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve the cantilever
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def solve_cantilever(L=4.0, H=2.0, Nx=2, Ny=2, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0,
                     nen=4, plane="stress", load="edge"):
    """Fixed at x = 0; vertical load on x = L. load = "edge": uniform traction q (N/m)
    by consistent nodal loads; load = "point": the total q*H at the top-right node."""
    Em = E_matrix(E, nu, plane)
    a, b, nodes, conn = mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny)
    n = len(nodes)
    K = np.zeros((2 * n, 2 * n))
    F = np.zeros(2 * n)
    k = element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t)
    for c in conn:
        d = dofs_of(c)
        K[np.ix_(d, d)] += k                                   # scatter-add by dof map
    if load == "point":
        F[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1] += q * H
    else:
        for c in conn:
            if np.isclose(nodes[c[1], 0], L):                   # element side 2-3 on the loaded edge
                if nen == 4:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 2; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 2
                else:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 6; F[2 * c[5] + 1] += 2 * q * b / 3; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 6
    fixed_nodes = np.where(np.isclose(nodes[:, 0], 0.0))[0]
    known = dofs_of(fixed_nodes)
    free = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(2 * n), known)
    U = np.zeros(2 * n)
    U[free] = np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(free, free)], F[free])
    Rk = K[known] @ U - F[known]                               # struck rows: support reactions
    Rx, Ry = Rk[0::2].sum(), Rk[1::2].sum()
    M = sum(-(nodes[nd, 1] - H / 2) * Rk[2 * i] for i, nd in enumerate(fixed_nodes))
    return dict(nen=nen, L=L, H=H, Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, a=a, b=b, E=E, nu=nu, t=t, q=q, plane=plane, Em=Em,
                nodes=nodes, conn=conn, K=K, F=F, U=U, known=known, reactions=dict(Rx=Rx, Ry=Ry, M=M),
                tip=U[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1])


def node_at_xy(nodes, x, y):
    return int(np.argmin(np.hypot(nodes[:, 0] - x, nodes[:, 1] - y)))


def node_at(res, x, y):
    """0-based index of the node nearest to (x, y)."""
    return node_at_xy(res["nodes"], x, y)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stresses
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def locate(res, x, y):
    """Element containing (x, y) and the natural coordinates of the point in it."""
    i = min(res["Nx"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(x / res["a"] + 1e-12))))
    j = min(res["Ny"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(y / res["b"] + 1e-12))))
    e = j * res["Nx"] + i
    x1, y1 = res["nodes"][res["conn"][e][0]]
    return e, 2 * (x - x1) / res["a"] - 1, 2 * (y - y1) / res["b"] - 1


def stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta):
    c = res["conn"][e]
    B = B_matrix(res["nen"], res["a"], res["b"], xi, eta)
    return res["Em"] @ (B @ res["U"][dofs_of(c)])


def stress_at(res, x, y):
    """(sxx, syy, sxy) at a global point, from the element that contains it."""
    e, xi, eta = locate(res, x, y)
    return stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta)


def principal(s):
    """sigma1, sigma2 and the angle (degrees) of sigma1 from x: the Mohr circle."""
    c = (s[0] + s[1]) / 2
    R = np.hypot((s[0] - s[1]) / 2, s[2])
    return c + R, c - R, 0.5 * np.degrees(np.arctan2(2 * s[2], s[0] - s[1]))


def von_mises(s):
    """Plane-stress von Mises stress."""
    return np.sqrt(s[0] ** 2 - s[0] * s[1] + s[1] ** 2 + 3 * s[2] ** 2)


def nodal_stresses(res, mode="averaged"):
    """Stresses at the nodes, as post-processors show them.
    "unaveraged": each element's own value at its nodes, (ne, nen, 3) - jumps visible;
    "averaged":   the mean over the elements sharing each node, (n, 3);
    "centroid":   one value per element, (ne, 3)."""
    nen, conn = res["nen"], res["conn"]
    if mode == "centroid":
        return np.array([stress_in_element(res, e, 0, 0) for e in range(len(conn))])
    un = np.array([[stress_in_element(res, e, XI[i], ETA[i]) for i in range(nen)] for e in range(len(conn))])
    if mode == "unaveraged":
        return un
    n = len(res["nodes"])
    av = np.zeros((n, 3)); cnt = np.zeros(n)
    for e, c in enumerate(conn):
        for i, nd in enumerate(c):
            av[nd] += un[e, i]; cnt[nd] += 1
    return av / cnt[:, None]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beam theory for comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def timoshenko_tip(L, H, E, nu, t, q, plane="stress", kappa=5 / 6):
    """Tip deflection magnitude: bending PL^3/(3EI) plus shear PL/(kappa G A)."""
    P = -q * H
    I, A, G = t * H ** 3 / 12, t * H, E / (2 * (1 + nu))
    Eb = E / (1 - nu ** 2) if plane == "strain" else E
    return P * L ** 3 / (3 * Eb * I), P * L / (kappa * G * A)


def plot_von_mises(res, filename="von_mises.png"):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator
    except ImportError:
        print("matplotlib is not installed: skipping the plot")
        return None
    xs = np.linspace(0, res["L"], 161); ys = np.linspace(0, res["H"], 81)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    Z = np.vectorize(lambda x, y: von_mises(stress_at(res, x, y)) / 1e3)(X, Y)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.6))
    # the fixed corners are singular: cap the colour scale at the 99th percentile
    levels = MaxNLocator(nbins=20).tick_values(0, np.percentile(Z, 99))
    cf = ax.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, cmap="jet", extend="max")
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("x (m)"); ax.set_ylabel("y (m)")
    fig.colorbar(cf, ax=ax, label="von Mises (kN/m2)")
    ax.set_title(f"{res['nen']}-node, {res['Nx']} x {res['Ny']} mesh")
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", filename)
    return filename


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Course examples
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=140)
    base = dict(L=4.0, H=2.0, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0)

    r = solve_cantilever(Nx=2, Ny=2, **base)
    print("Text cantilever, 4-node 2 x 2 mesh, (3.44)-(3.49) (nodes 1-3 along the bottom)")
    U = r["U"].reshape(-1, 2)
    for i, (u, v) in enumerate(U):
        print(f"  node {i + 1}: u = {u:+.6f}  v = {v:+.6f} m")
    print(f"  tip deflection = {r['tip']:.4f} m  (text: -0.131)")
    R = r["reactions"]
    print(f"  reactions: Rx = {R['Rx']:.1f} N, Ry = {R['Ry']:.1f} N, M = {R['M']:.1f} N m  (10 kN up, 40 kN m)")
    s = stress_at(r, 3.5, 1.3) / 1e3
    s1, s2, th = principal(s)
    print(f"  stress at (3.5, 1.3) = {np.round(s, 1)} kN/m2  (315.2, -44.9, -310.9)")
    print(f"  principal {s1:.1f}, {s2:.1f} kN/m2 at {th:.1f} deg; von Mises {von_mises(s):.1f}  (494.4, -224.1; 636.8)")

    bend, shear = timoshenko_tip(**base)
    print(f"\nConvergence of the tip deflection; Timoshenko beam {bend:.3f} + {shear:.3f} = {bend + shear:.3f} m")
    for nen, meshes in ((4, [(2, 1), (2, 2), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)]), (8, [(2, 1), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8)])):
        for Nx, Ny in meshes:
            rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, nen=nen, **base)
            print(f"  {nen}-node {Nx:2d} x {Ny:<2d} dofs {rr['U'].size:5d}  tip {rr['tip']:.4f} m")

    r8 = solve_cantilever(Nx=16, Ny=8, nen=8, **base)
    print(f"\n8-node 16 x 8: sxx(2.0, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 2.0, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} kN/m2 (beam theory 900);"
          f" sxx(3.5, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 3.5, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} (beam 225: end effect, St-Venant)")

    print("\nFixed corner: sxx at the centroid of the top-left element grows with every refinement (a singularity)")
    for Nx, Ny in ((8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)):
        rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, **base)
        print(f"  4-node {Nx} x {Ny}: {stress_at(rr, rr['a'] / 2, 2 - rr['b'] / 2)[0] / 1e3:.0f} kN/m2")

    plot_von_mises(r8, "von_mises_q8_16x8.png")

    What to doApa perlu dibuat Look up a term; type in the box to filter.     Workbench project schematicThe chain of cells Engineering Data → Geometry → Model/Mesh → Setup → Solution → Results: the six steps of the hand calculation.Rantaian sel Engineering Data → Geometry → Model/Mesh → Setup → Solution → Results: enam langkah pengiraan tangan.
    Analysis Type 2D · 2D BehaviorGeometry-cell setting that makes the model two-dimensional; in Mechanical, the choice Plane Stress or Plane Strain, with a Thickness for plane stress.Tetapan sel Geometry yang menjadikan model dua dimensi; dalam Mechanical, pilihan Plane Stress atau Plane Strain, dengan Thickness bagi plane stress.
    Element OrderLinear (4-node: PLANE182, thermal PLANE55) or Quadratic (8-node: PLANE183, thermal PLANE77); Program Controlled gives quadratic for 2D solids.Linear (4-node: PLANE182, thermal PLANE55) atau Quadratic (8-node: PLANE183, thermal PLANE77); Program Controlled memberi quadratic bagi 2D solid.
    Edge Sizing · Element Size · Face MeshingNumber of divisions on an edge, one target size for the whole face, and the request for a mapped (structured) quadrilateral mesh.Bilangan bahagian pada satu tepi, satu saiz sasaran untuk seluruh muka, dan permintaan untuk mesh segi empat berpeta (berstruktur).
    enhanced strain · Element ControlAn option of the linear element that adds internal modes so it bends without locking; Element Control: Manual with full integration gives the textbook Q4.Pilihan linear element yang menambah mod dalaman supaya ia melentur tanpa locking; Element Control: Manual dengan full integration memberi Q4 buku teks.
    Fixed Support · DisplacementEssential conditions: all dofs, or chosen components, of an edge set to zero or a value.Essential condition: semua dof, atau komponen yang dipilih, pada satu tepi ditetapkan kepada sifar atau satu nilai.
    Force · Pressure (on an edge)Natural conditions: a total force spread over the edge, or a force per unit area of the edge face; Mechanical turns either into consistent nodal loads.Natural condition: jumlah daya yang disebarkan pada tepi, atau daya per unit luas muka tepi; Mechanical menukar kedua-duanya menjadi consistent nodal load.
    Internal Heat GenerationThe source qh in W m−3 on a body; with thickness t its total is qh × area × t.Sumber qh dalam W m−3 pada jasad; dengan ketebalan t jumlahnya qh × luas × t.
    Reaction probeForce Reaction, Moment Reaction or heat reaction on a support or prescribed temperature: the struck rows of [K]{U} − {R}. The first check of every run.Force Reaction, Moment Reaction atau reaction haba pada support atau suhu yang ditetapkan: baris yang dibuang [K]{U} − {R}. Semakan pertama setiap run.
    Averaged · Unaveraged · Elemental MeanDisplay Options of a stress result: nodal average, each element’s own nodal values, one centroid value per element.Display Option bagi keputusan stress: purata nodal, nilai node setiap element sendiri, satu nilai centroid setiap element.
    rigid-body mode · weak springsA motion the supports do not stop (here, translation in x); the solver warns and may add weak springs to solve anyway — the warning is the evidence.Gerakan yang tidak dihalang oleh support (di sini, translasi dalam x); solver memberi amaran dan mungkin menambah weak springs untuk tetap menyelesaikan — amaran itulah buktinya.
    input error · idealisation errorA wrong load, unit or support (shows in the reaction) against a wrong modelling choice that equilibrium cannot catch (shows only against a prediction).Load, unit atau support yang salah (kelihatan pada reaction) berbanding pilihan pemodelan yang salah yang tidak dapat ditangkap oleh keseimbangan (hanya kelihatan berbanding ramalan).
    verificationSolving the equations right: checks that are exact for the model — hand calculation, patch test, analytical solution, reactions, a second code.Menyelesaikan persamaan dengan betul: semakan yang tepat bagi model — pengiraan tangan, patch test, penyelesaian analitikal, reaction, kod kedua.
    validationSolving the right equations: comparison of the model with measurements on the real structure.Menyelesaikan persamaan yang betul: perbandingan model dengan pengukuran pada struktur sebenar.
    patch testA small mesh of unequal elements under a load whose exact solution is a constant stress; a consistent element reproduces it to round-off.Mesh kecil element yang tidak sama di bawah load yang penyelesaian tepatnya ialah stress malar; element yang konsisten menghasilkannya semula hingga round-off.
    stage gateA check that must be passed, with evidence, before the next stage of the project starts.Semakan yang mesti dilepasi, dengan bukti, sebelum peringkat projek seterusnya bermula.
    observed order pThe rate measured from three meshes: successive changes shrink by 2p per halving of the element size.Kadar yang diukur daripada tiga mesh: perubahan berturut-turut mengecil sebanyak 2p bagi setiap pembahagian dua saiz element.
    Kirsch solutionThe exact stresses around a circular hole in an infinite plate in tension: 3σ0 at the edge of the hole (Kt = 3).Stress tepat di sekeliling lubang bulat dalam plat tak terhingga dalam tegangan: 3σ0 di tepi lubang (Kt = 3).
    GenAI logThe record of prompts, accepted and rejected AI output, and the gate that caught each error; marked with the reflection.Rekod prompt, output AI yang diterima dan ditolak, dan gate yang menangkap setiap ralat; dinilai bersama refleksi.
